Transactions: $61.67 on 2016-12-27 03:33 (online); $9.94 on 2016-12-27 04:31 (online); $92.77 on 2016-12-27 04:50 (online); $92.87 on 2016-12-27 04:54 (online); $92.91 on 2016-12-27 05:07 (online); $92.81 on 2016-12-27 05:09 (online). The activity was flagged by a customer report trigger and corroborated by graph analysis of this card's transaction history, and by 2 other card(s) sharing the same device/region origin. This filing is required under Policy Section 3a because exposure exceeds $1,000. Card C11923-K2 has been recommended for blocking and reissue; any connected cards have been placed under monitoring pending further review.
